cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory
Group=inventory
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure

# Sandboxing: confine writes to /var/lib/inventory, block privilege escalation
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
UMask=0027

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
